question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Girls, Boys, Students

(G : Girls; B : Boys; S : Students)
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as shown below :

 
• Some Girls are Students.
 
• Some Boys are students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d021e8938006b0a982d884e5e4a40f93ef43a496c1b61f7d9422c083193cee8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
